US govt’s one sentence USCIS rule change that can impact H-1B visa extension forms
description: DHS has proposed a rule change that could affect the approval of visa extensions for foreign workers. School founded by Zuckerberg's wife Priscilla Chan closed 10 years later
description: Priscilla Chan's innovative primary school in East Palo Alto has officially closed after nearly ten years of operation. Funded by the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, the school focused on integrating education with healthcare for low-income families. Although it served nearly 540 children, the academic performance fell short of expectations, leading to its closure. CZI has committed $50 million to support affected families during this transition.
